raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in understanding the task. The task was to find out the film released on July 31, 1974, by Buena Vista Distribution. However, instead of recognizing that The Bears and I matched this criteria from the beginning, the Planner instructed WebSurfer to find a film released between The Bears and I and Oceans, erroneously assuming they were different when the task itself was self-resolving. The Bears and I was indeed released on that date. The conversation prematurely included attempts to locate another intermediary title, which was unnecessary.
